content_metadata.description: A humorous episode of the Craig Ferguson Show featuring guest Olga Kurylenko, with playful banter and absurd humor.

What is Olga Kurylenko's unexpected favorite animal?

narrativeProgression.description: The conversation shifts to Olga's past acting role, giving the host an opportunity for more playful banter.
